text_block_list.text:
"Chrono Genesis,
Loves Only You."
And Curren Bouquetd'or.

The Shuka Sho, where a dazzling battle between
the girls dominating the Tiara route was eagerly anticipated—

Yet those hopes were thoroughly shattered
ear early September.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I injured a nail on my right hoof...
so I have decided to withdraw from the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I intend to adjust my schedule to make sure
it is fully healed by the 'Queen Elizabeth II Cup' this fall.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Still, I really... wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I'm sorry. Whenever I remember how full of energy you were at the summer training campâ

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san was also out of shape
and had to sit out the Sprinters Stakes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Being able to run in races in good health isn't something to take for granted, is it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry, this won't do.
I shouldn't keep hanging my head down.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best for both of them, too.
Just then—an interview video featuring the Umamusume confirmed to run in the Shuka Sho was scheduled to be released on official URA UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
Curren Bouquetd'or-san, the floor is yours.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Do you have any special feelings toward the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Not being able to run together with Loves-san...
is indeed regrettable."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yet that is precisely why,
in order to make my dream come true—
I want to run with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: "By the way, what is your dream, Bouquet-san?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To present a golden bouquet
to Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
May the day come when victories are gathered and offered—
and through them, a gentle light shines upon him.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
May the day come when victories are gathered and offered—
and through them, a gentle light shines upon her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: With that prayer in mind—she hoped that at the Shuka Sho, she could gather a bouquet of autumn flowers of victory.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: How wonderful... That story really lets you feel the bond between the two of you.

Ever since we first formed our partnership,
her dream has remained completely unchanged—

Her kindness in always placing me at the center
of her dreams warmed my heart.
choice_data_list: (She really is such a kind girl.)
(She really is such a kind girl.)

text_block_list.text:
Could there be any other Umamusume who cares
this deeply for a mere Trainer like me?

With those hopes in mind, on the day the video was released—
I logged on to UmaTube, and...

An exclusive interview video featuring only Chrono Genesis
had been newly uploaded.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho, the final race of the Triple Tiara, is sometimes even referred to as the race to decide the strongest Tiara Umamusume of the generation.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's a pity about Loves-chan...
However, even if we aren't all together,
we must prove the strength of our generation—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In the light of Almond Eye-san's brilliance,
our entire generation is cast into the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“...I want to run stronger than anyone from any era,
and seize victory at the Shuka Sho.”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And so,
I want to engrave into the pages of the Twinkle Series that ours was an exceptionally brilliant generation—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
These are my special feelings right now...
The dream I hold for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "She takes a bird's-eye view of the racing world. Anticipation is mounting for her performance in the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Truly impressive.
To capture the spotlight with just a single word.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, just a little—she resembles
Loves-san back during the Oaks.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (My heart is racing. ...No, but still...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I could never become like them—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I'm sorry. ...Um.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Chrono-san is a formidable opponent. But I want to fight in the Shuka Sho in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Holding autumn flowers in hand—and in doing so, surely,
I shall gather all the spotlight onto you...
That was what I was just pondering.

Spurred on by those powerful words,
another day began—

Returning to the trainer's office and turning on the TV,
an information program featuring Chrono Genesis
was playing.
—Curren Bouquetd'or put on a magnificent run at the Oaks.
choice_data_list: (Still, the public's evaluation hasn't caught up yet.)

text_block_list.text:
You could say it was bad luck.
Or you could say I failed to provide enough support
to help you overcome that luck.

"Next time, I want her to shine as her true self.
So that she receives the recognition she truly deserves—"
choice_data_list: (I'll just have to work even harder.)
(I'll just have to work even harder.)

text_block_list.text: That determination swelled even further—and then.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Bouquet-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
With Loves-chan not here,
I consider you to be my greatest rival.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Having watched you gain strength and transform day by day, I believe I understand your true potential well.
...However.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Even so, just for today—on this grand stage, I will win...!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
But I... want to win too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I don't have eye-catching talent
like you or Loves-san, Chrono-san, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Then that is all the more reason why! I want to shine the brightest in this Shuka Sho!

Holding their own feelings close, the final battle of the Tiara line—
the Shuka Sho, has raised its curtains!
